newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T up after Morris gain, BZW rates buy.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T up after Morris gain, BZW rates buy.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc rose on Friday, tracking a rise in Philip Morris Cos Inc shares in New York on Thursday and as analysts at BZW repeated a "buy" rating on the stock, dealers said.
After Morris shares closed $7/8 higher at $41-5/8, B.A.T shares were up 4-1/2p to 523-1/2 by 0923 GMT in volume of just under one million shares.

Morris chief executive Geoffrey Bible told the company's annual shareholders meeting that it would listen to and explore all reasonable proposals to settle the hundreds of lawsuits the industry has attracted.

With speculation about prospects for a settlement in U.S. tobacco litigation likely to intensify, BZW analysts were said to have advised investors that expected volatility in tobacco shares should present opportunities to buy stock at attractive levels.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
B.A.T holds its annual meeting later today.
